articles.title: These Two Planets Are Fluffier Than Cotton Candy!
articles.summary: Astronomers found two giant planets that are less dense than cotton candy. They're called super-puffs, and they float 1,113 light-years away. Only a handful of these fluffy worlds are known!

articles.title: Did Vikings Really Shoot Fire Arrows at Funeral Boats?
articles.summary: Movies show Vikings sending burning boats out to sea with fire arrows. But experts say there's no real evidence for it. The fiery funeral might be a Hollywood invention!

articles.title: 31-Year-Old Swimmer Breaks Record at Asian Games!
articles.summary: Xu Jiayu, 31, won the 100m backstroke at the 2026 Asian Games with a record time of 51.98 seconds. He's been winning Chinese titles since he was 18!
